records.narr_swing_public: The hinge has MOVED, not closed - 2026Q2 resolved the unit-economics half (NIMAL inflected 18%->21% with gains in all 3 largest markets, first consolidated reversal of the 39.8% FY2023 -> 22.4% FY2025 slide, and the 4-quarter consensus-EPS miss streak broke on a +6.2% beat), so the question is no longer CAN the economics inflect but whether management will ever ALLOW the leverage to reach EBIT: margin was 6.7%, -550bps YoY, with the 2.5pp QoQ OpEx dilution explicitly reinvested rather than banked, GAAP EPS down YoY for a third straight quarter, and a now-permanent memory-chip cost in POS devic
